items.title: Mushrooms for the Mind & Immune System | Paul Stamets
items.description: Paul Stamets is widely regarded as the father of modern applied mycology for his work on fungi and their applications in human health. We discuss how mushrooms and other fungi affect, and can improve, our immune system; how certain non-psychedelic mushrooms can enhance cognition and brain plasticity; and the use of psilocybin for depression, anxiety, and other mental health conditions, as well as important safety considerations. This episode is for anyone seeking to learn more about the biology of fungi and their medicinal and other uses. Read the episode show notes at hubermanlab.com. items.title: Essentials: How Emotions & Social Factors Impact Learning | Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang
items.description: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang, EdD, a professor of education and psychology at the University of Southern California (USC) and director of the USC Center for Affective Neuroscience, Development, Learning and Education (CANDLE). We discuss how emotions, stories and culture shape the way we perceive the world, learn and build a sense of self. We also explain how our narratives can foster empathy or dehumanization, and how education can be redesigned to engage curiosity, meaning-making and the development of the whole person. Read the episode show notes at hubermanlab.com.
